items.headline: Hormuz tanker traffic slows amid Iran tensions
items.summary: Reuters reported that tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz slowed over the weekend as US-Iran talks stalled, keeping oil prices roughly flat and adding freight-routing risk for crude and product traders.

items.headline: ACER consults on REMIT-EMIR reporting overlap
items.summary: ACER opened a consultation on guidance for reporting energy derivative transactions under both REMIT and EMIR, aiming to reduce duplicate reporting caused by inconsistent scope definitions across the two regimes.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market seen growing sharply
items.summary: A new market report projects the commodity trade finance sector to expand from about $59.7 billion in 2026 to $81.45 billion by 2030, driven by blockchain-based settlement and real-time risk monitoring adoption, particularly in Asia-Pacific.

items.headline: CTRM vendor landscape sees fresh product moves
items.summary: CTRM Center highlighted new vendor activity this month, including testing specialist Trinitatum's outreach on purpose-built CTRM testing tools and further detail on Sinara's proprietary trading platform.
